description: With the Outpost reclaimed but war looming, Talon explores deeper Blackblood powers while Gwynn defends her throne against the Prime Order, new claimants and enemies inside the walls.

s02e01.description: Talon summons a dangerous new presence tied to her childhood while Gwynn prepares the Outpost for war and Garret continues his hunt for Dred.

s02e02.description: Talon faces a new rival, Gwynn struggles to hold the Outpost and Baron Tobin arrives with an outrageous proposal that immediately complicates the balance of power.

s02e03.description: Rebb secretly offers Gwynn a Blackblood army, Tobin pursues the queen and Naya attempts to reshape Janzo into someone Talon might finally notice.

s02e04.description: Gwynn is taken hostage for a ransom only Talon can pay, pushing Talon toward a risky ally while Janzo tests his newly reinvented image.

s02e05.description: Wythers races to save Garret, Gwynn answers Tobin's proposal and Talon and Zed uncover a key to greater Blackblood power as Garret accepts a darker mission.

s02e06.description: Talon and Zed travel toward Talon's childhood home while Tobin tries to prove himself, Janzo experiments with plaguelings and Naya's Prime Order past catches up with her.

s02e07.description: Zed searches for Talon after her disappearance, Tobin confronts a hated cousin and an unexpected visitor disrupts a royal ceremony at the Outpost.

s02e08.description: Talon and Zed pursue a killer during a rescue mission while Gwynn orders Janzo to find a cure for the plaguelings and deal with a dangerously confused patient.

s02e09.description: With the Outpost under siege, Talon and Zed uncover an enemy from her childhood while a key prisoner plots escape and Milus departs in anger.

s02e10.description: Talon and Zed unlock a power she does not trust, an assassin stalks the Outpost and Naya confronts her former master as Garret adopts a new objective.

s02e11.description: Garret encounters Talon as a Prime Order captive, a rival claimant threatens Gwynn's throne and Janzo races to cure the plaguelings before a devastating weapon is unleashed.

s02e12.description: Garret faces an old enemy while Talon fights the Prime Order, Naya's imprisonment divides Janzo and his allies, and the enemy army closes on the Outpost.

s02e13.description: The Prime Order launches its assault, forcing Talon into a desperate plan while Garret seeks revenge and Gwynn must decide the fate of someone she once trusted.
